title: buildFeeBumpTransaction throws "Inner transaction must have time bounds" for a v0 transaction without time bounds

target.versions_affected: 17.4.0 and main 5243062f (the code involved is the same in both; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: TransactionBuilder.buildFeeBumpTransaction converts a v0 inner transaction to v1 and throws when it has no time bounds, although stellar-core converts such a transaction to PRECOND_NONE with the same hash, so a valid pre-signed v0 transaction without time bounds cannot be fee-bumped through the SDK. A loud refusal; nothing is built wrongly (the issue states impact low).

entries.expected: buildFeeBumpTransaction accepts a v0 transaction without time bounds and wraps it with PRECOND_NONE, keeping its hash
entries.observed: No conformance fact of the kit fee-bumps a parsed transaction. By hand on 17.4.0 with the mainnet transaction eef91974… (ledger 18365879, a signed ENVELOPE_TYPE_TX_V0 with no time bounds): buildFeeBumpTransaction throws 'Inner transaction must have time bounds'; its v1 form with PRECOND_NONE has the same hash and can be fee-bumped.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's script on 17.4.0 (main 5243062f has the same code): buildFeeBumpTransaction throws 'Inner transaction must have time bounds' for mainnet transaction eef91974ddae9a5a8e0ff15e9a7044e845c38a2c7ccaa02cdda8d8c55b0d657e; the v1 form with PRECOND_NONE hashes to the same value and fee-bumps.
evidence.expected_basis: Time bounds are optional in TransactionV0; stellar-core's convertForV13 (src/transactions/TransactionBridge.cpp) sets PRECOND_TIME only when timeBounds is present, and the v1 form has the same hash (CAP-15).

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on 17.4.0 before filing on 2026-11-19: buildFeeBumpTransaction throws for eef91974….

queries: stellar/js-stellar-sdk: every issue and pull request since 2026-11-01

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/js-stellar-sdk/issues/1911; this record restates the public issue.
